articleTitle: An interleaved high-performance AC/DC converter
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: An interleaved high-performance AC/DC converter is presented in this paper. It includes two elementary single-stage high performance ZVS AC/DC converters which only include four power switches to correct power factor in their input side and regulate their dc output voltage. Moreover, they are parallel connection and are operated at interleaved mode to share the output power. The proposed converter does not only decrease the current stress of power semiconductor devices but reduces the input ripple current the output ripple current. Furthermore, they adopt LLC resonant technique to get ZVS on power switches in them. A simple frequency modulation control strategy is used in proposed converter to synthesize a low harmonics sinusoidal input current waveform and achieve well dynamic regulation. A 1000W presented converter is design to observe its performance.

articleTitle: Large multimodal models in virtual reality: advancing immersive experiences through artificial intelligence integration
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: Recent advances in artificial intelligence, specifically in large multimodal models (LMMs), have spurred new possibilities in virtual reality (VR) environments. LMMs, capable of processing and integrating diverse forms of data such as text, audio, video, and sensory inputs, are poised to enhance VR systems by creating more intuitive, adaptive, and immersive experiences. This paper explores the synergy between LMMs and VR, outlining key applications, technical challenges, and future opportunities. We delve into how LMMs improve user interaction, expand content generation capabilities, and foster more realistic virtual environments.

articleTitle: A consulting system based on joints range of motion for bike fitting
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: Bike fitting is a necessary procedure in cycling to prevent injury and improve performance. The most important requirement is to adjust the height of saddle and handlebars to make the rider feel comfortable and improve performance. An app used in a mobile device to achieve bike fitting more easily. Such an app is called a consulting system for bike fitting based on data driven. It should evaluate kinematic variables to give a recommendation for adjustment of heights of saddle and handlebars. In this study, an app was developed used in a PAD proposed. The evaluation and recommendation of cycling are based on joints range of motion. There are two joints range of motion used for evaluation. They are knee angle extension and back angle. A skeleton system is proposed to describe the whole cycling motion. It simulates to rotate calf, thigh, back and arm to make a better condition. The simulation result gives a guideline to adjust of heights of saddle and handlebars. The result shows it is convenient to use and get high performance.

articleTitle: Generate tree graph based on multiplication process
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: This paper introduces a systematic method for the enumeration of tree graphs. Initially, the paper proposes a multiplication process to generate new tree graphs with an additional vertex from existing tree graph with one less vertex. Specifically, it starts with a tree graph withv-1 vertices and adds one vertex to obtain a tree graph withvvertices. Next, the paper utilizes the topological encoding of graphs to efficiently identify isomorphism between tree graphs. Isomorphism refers to the structural equivalence of two graphs, differing only in vertex labelling. Through topological encoding, it is possible to quickly determine whether two tree graphs are isomorphic, thus avoiding redundant calculations in the enumeration process. Then, the paper develops an algorithm for the automatic enumeration of tree graphs. This algorithm can systematically generate all possible tree graphs without human intervention. This paper offers an automated method for generating and identifying tree graphs. Through this method, researchers can more efficiently explore the properties of tree graphs.

articleTitle: Diet advisor: an image-based food intake analysis and meal recommendation system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: This paper introduces an innovative nutrition system designed to promote healthier dietary habits through a user-friendly interface. The system analyses food images to estimate the nutritional content of meals and offers personalized recommendations based on individual characteristics, such as diet, age, height, weight, and physical activity level, which influence metabolic processes. By utilizing advanced deep learning and computer vision technologies, the system provides accurate predictions of nutritional content and gives useful meal suggestions while maintaining efficiency in processing time, offering a balance between accuracy and user convenience.

articleTitle: The role of sustainable brand design in shaping innovative consumer preferences for personal care products
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: By implementing innovative and sustainable brand strategies, companies can not only enhance their public image but also effectively stimulate consumer demand for environmentally friendly products. Driven by the global wave of sustainable development, consumer environmental awareness has significantly increased, forcing companies to rethink their strategic goals beyond traditional profit-driven models. This trend is particularly evident in the personal care products sector, especially in the post-pandemic era. Many brands have successfully consolidated their market position and enhanced brand recognition by combining innovation with sustainable design, further encouraging consumers to embrace eco-friendly products. This study, based on consumer surveys, reveals how innovative efforts in environmental design elements-such as material innovation, packaging design, and commitments to social and environmental responsibility-profoundly influence consumer purchasing decisions. Consumers expect brands to continuously innovate and incorporate sustainable principles into their designs to more actively address social and environmental needs. The findings further indicate that companies that effectively integrate innovative sustainable design can significantly boost brand loyalty and market competitiveness while playing a critical role in promoting environmental awareness.

articleTitle: Long-term traffic forecasting in smart traffic management: a Taiwan case study based on the informer architecture for highway traffic analysis
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: This study introduces an innovative traffic speed prediction framework for Taiwan's highways using the Informer model, a Transformer-based deep learning architecture designed for long-sequence time series forecasting. This work is novel in applying the Informer model to highway traffic management in Taiwan, capturing complex traffic patterns and long-term dependencies. Addressing the challenges posed by rapid urbanization and increasing traffic demand, the model offers a new solution to congestion management and road safety enhancement. By effectively analysing historical traffic speed and flow data, it provides accurate and actionable predictions for real-time traffic management. The model's robustness across diverse traffic conditions and peak hours enables highway authorities to optimize lane usage, speed limits, and control strategies, leading to reduced congestion and improved safety. Experimental results confirm the model’s high accuracy compared to actual data, positioning it as a promising tool for advancing smart traffic systems in Taiwan. This approach offers potential for broader application across other road networks, paving the way for intelligent traffic solutions.

articleTitle: Multi-theory fusion-driven optimization of pressure-reducing glasses design
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: Aiming at the discomfort of wearing glasses for myopic people, this study aims to improve the wearing comfort of glasses through innovative design. Considering the pressure of wearing glasses, after user demand analysis, determining the influencing factors and weights, and applying various theories to optimise the design, the reasonable structure and choice of materials can alleviate the pressure on the nose and ears to a certain extent, and improve the wearing comfort and user satisfaction. This innovative design provides new ideas for the design of pressure-reducing glasses, and it is hoped that it can promote the design of glasses to make further breakthroughs in meeting the needs of users and improving the wearing experience.

articleTitle: An all-digital CMOS pulse-shrinking mechanism for time measurement
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: This paper presents a newly developed all-digital CMOS pulse-shrinking mechanism for time measurement, aimed at enhancing time resolution and improving circuit performance under process and temperature variations. In the previous all-digital mechanism, the pulse-shrinking amount (time resolution) was determined by adjusting the number of NOT gates in the inhomogeneous stage to achieve sub-gate resolution. The new mechanism introduces buffer gates to replace the original NOT gates, with the NOT gates simply added in the inhomogeneous stage to form these buffer gates. An analysis of the resolution is provided, demonstrating that the buffer-based technique effectively improves resolution compared to the inverter-based approach. The all-digital CMOS mechanism was implemented using a 0.35-μm CMOS TSMC process for performance evaluation. Simulation results show that the proposed mechanism achieves significant resolution improvement with greater stability against process and temperature variations.

articleTitle: Implicit indication of planar MOSFET and 3D FinFET by fitting electrical characteristic curves
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: Modified conventional formulas have been a feasibly important alternative to fit the as-measured characteristic curves of transistors. Three principle parameters, (k<sub>N</sub>, V<sub>th</sub>, λ)_VGS, may be successfully determined depending on various VGS. Somehow, the as-measured curves are not perfectly matched by the modified formulas leaving a large discrepancy as the triode region approaches to the saturation region, i.e., around V<sub>DS</sub>~(V<sub>GS</sub>-V<sub>th</sub>). The large discrepancies always fall behind the maximum slope of the IDS versus VDS characteristic curves. The whole picture is that mass carriers travel at the same speed but suddenly turn fast according to V DS where there exists a maximum varying speed. This maximum abrupt changing speed may radiate comparatively large radiation disturbing the path ahead and thus vibrating lattice such that the obstacles are generated. Those obstacles are called kink effects. The mechanism is created and the corrections well and impressively help fit the electrical curves.

articleTitle: Research on the collaborative role of artificial intelligence, big data, and the internet of things in visual perception of smart cities
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: This paper elaborates on the positive visual perception brought by the collaborative role of artificial intelligence, big data, and the Internet of Things from multiple perspectives such as reinforcing traffic safety through intelligent recognition, providing lifestyle guidance through efficient analysis, supporting autonomous driving through data, and upgrading industrial ecology through intelligent linkage. It summarizes the collaborative role of artificial intelligence, big data, and the Internet of Things in the visual perception of smart cities from three aspects: promoting data integration and exchange, optimizing intelligent algorithms and models, and improving decision intelligence and response.

articleTitle: A study on the strategic concerns for enhancing residents' privacy and safeguarding cultural authenticity in historical cultural towns in China
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: The objective of this study is to analyze the impact of daily privacy on the level of support and authenticity perception among residents in Chinese ancient towns during cultural tourism development. The study aims to identify challenges related to cultural heritage conservation and draw policymakers' attention to planning and policy-making efforts for historic town preservation. To achieve this goal, it is recommended that needed research to be conducted, including more detailed observations and semi- structured professional interviews with research groups, in order to understand how visitor behavior affects residents' daily privacy and the preservation of their authentic lifestyles. More importantly, strategic factors relevant to ancient town planning and conservation policies will be explored. This emphasizes not only acknowledging the economic benefits associated with tourism development but also ensuring active resident engagement in the industry while addressing concerns about potential violations of their daily privacy.

articleTitle: Research on the application of digital cloud monitoring molds in the production of embedded plastic-gears
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: This study uses pressure and temperature sensors installed at the gate and the end of the mold. There are 2 pressure sensors and 2 temperature sensors. When the captured sensing data is compared with the original setting data. If there is any difference, it will be judged as a defective product. Its pressure sensing module model LS-B-127-500-H has a maximum pressure sensing range of 0~2000bar and a sensing accuracy of ±0.5bar. The temperature sensing module model is LS-QTTB, the sensing temperature range is 0~200℃, and the accuracy is ±2℃. In the cloud experiment part, in the gate measurement value part: (1) The simulated peak pressure at the gate position is 387 bar, and the actual sensing measurement result is 367 bar, with an error of 5%. The temperature simulation numerical data is 77℃, and the actual sensing measurement result is 77.1℃, with an error of 0.2%. (2) Under the optimized parameter settings under the Taguchi method, the peak pressure of the gate simulation result is 672 bar, and the actual sensor measurement result is 644 bar, with an error of 1%. The temperature simulation is 66°C, and the actual sensing measurement result is 60°C, with an error of 10%.

articleTitle: Exploring relationship between running amount and sleep quality using data mining technology
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: Good exercise habits and sleep quality are extremely important for everyone. The aims of this study are to quantify sleep quality, and to further analyse the relationship between sleep quality and running amount, through a decision tree, and then to recommend running amounts to improve sleep quality. The results found people having good sleep quality with two cases: (1) the daily running: time is between 20.5 and 57.5 minutes and distance is greater than 0.75 km; and (2) the average weekly running: time is less than or equal to 40.05 minutes, distance is greater than 0.85 km, and frequency is greater than 2.5 times.

articleTitle: An AI-based inspection system for ski goggle lens manufacturing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: Detecting defects on non-planar surfaces, like ski goggle lenses, is challenging due to their curvature, which creates uneven lighting, shadows, and focus issues in image capturing. Texture variations distort how defects appear, and their tiny size and similarity further complicate detection. These factors make accurate detection and classification difficult even with advanced deep-learning models. This paper proposes an AI-based defect detection system for ski goggle lenses containing an image acquisition system and a comprehensive defect detection and classification framework to address these issues. Firstly, the system utilizes a custom-designed lighting and image acquisition model containing three high-resolution cameras to capture the entire lens surface from multiple angles. Secondly, a SIFT-based image stitching algorithm is subsequently employed to transform the three-dimensional shape of the ski goggle lens into a two-dimensional image, which is used for defect inspection. Finally, an adaptive energy analysis-based algorithm is proposed to detect five types of defects and then classify them by YOLOv8. Experiments conducted on 30 ski goggle lens samples from a Taiwanese manufacturer demonstrate superior defect detection and classification performance, significantly improving the management of complexities associated with ski goggle lens quality.

articleTitle: The performance effect of CEO overconfidence on corporate long-term valuation: the case of international mergers and acquisitions
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: The effect of CEO overconfidence on firm performance has arouse great research interests because many CEOs are found characterized by overconfidence. By analysing international merger and acquisition (IMA) investments conducted by US companies between the periods of 2010-2020, this study finds different contingency effect of CEO overconfidence on corporate IMA long-term valuation, specifically from the following three perspectives: the degree of international diversification, degree of industrial interrelation, and culture distance between the merger and target. Findings of the present study can contribute to the literature by highlighting the importance of taking a contingency view to assess the influence of managerial overconfidence on the outcomes of firm strategic investment.

articleTitle: Holoembryo acupuncture based on the principle of topology
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: A topological structure, as defined in the mathematical field of topology, must possess homeomorphism; furthermore, its intrinsic qualities must ensure that it does not lose the continuity of its mapping function within the system due to changes in the topological manifold. Western medicine indicates that the topological correspondence of two holoembryos embodying the motor and sensory nervous systems is formed between the cerebral somatosensory–motor cortex in the central nervous system and the peripheral nervous system. The concepts of the “holoembryo” and “bio-holographic” were proposed in Chinese holography medicine to reflect the translational relationships between the overall messages in a living organism and the simplified partial images; these concepts were also used to establish the acupuncture concepts of diagnostic holoembryos and therapeutic holoembryos. Building on the premise that De Qi of acupuncture can generate muscle potential and produce frequency messages, the present study developed a therapeutic integration of Holoembryo of Zhu’s Scalp Acupuncture and Holoembryo of Eight Major Acupoints. Additionally, the present study demonstrated that through the transmission of neural messages, De Qi can reveal the topological properties of the nervous system regarding neurophysiological mechanisms and effects.

articleTitle: Design evaluation and optimization of thermos cups based on analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: This article mainly applies the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) to evaluate and optimize the design schemes of four types of thermos cups that are well-selling on a certain e-commerce platform, to provide reference for consumers during their purchasing decisions. First, quantitative evaluation principles were adopted to select basic indicators for choosing thermos cup designs from three aspects: economy, appearance, and functionality. Then, AHP was used to conduct a comprehensive quantitative evaluation of the selected four thermos cup design schemes, establishing a corresponding quantitative comparison matrix. The Step-real AHP Software was utilized to analyze and compute the data, resulting in the maximum eigenvalue and eigenvector of the quantitative comparison matrix, followed by a consistency test. Finally, based on the results of the consistency test, the quantitative evaluation data for the selected four thermos cup designs were optimized. The results of this study provide, to some extent, optimal quantitative indicators for consumers when purchasing thermos cups, reducing the randomness of the selection process and offering a useful reference for future evaluations of related product designs.

articleTitle: Improving battery safety: reliable internal battery temperature calculation using EIS technology
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: To prevent thermal runaway in battery energy storage systems, accurate temperature monitoring is required. The inaccuracy with which typical surface temperature sensors portray inner battery temperatures may cause delays in detecting overheating. To overcome this, the battery's internal temperature (BIT) is determined using electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS). This paper reviews four EIS-based BIT estimation techniques: phase shift (PoI), real part (RoI), imaginary part (IoI), and impedance magnitude (MoI). Based on studies with 28 batteries, it also makes recommendations for frequency settings that improve the accuracy of BIT estimates.

articleTitle: Application of digital technology in jade carving crafts
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: Emerging digital technologies have been widely applied to the fields of design and processing of jade carving crafts. One of the methods is to combine 3D scanning technology, 3D digital design and CNC processing technology for the design and processing of decorative jade carvings. The application of digital technology can realize the digital design and new processing methods of decorative jade carvings. In this article, the shape characteristics of jade materials were obtained by using a structured light 3D scanner, and on this basis, combined with 3D digital design technology (Rhino, ZBrush, KeyShot) and CNC processing programming (ArtForm) and carving processing, decorative jade carving creations were carried out. The introduction of digital technology into the creation of decorative jade carvings not only efficiently presents design creativity and shortens the design and processing cycle, but also improves the scalability of subsequent applications. It is foreseeable that with the promotion and application of digital technology and friendly human-computer interaction, digital technology will provide a feasible new direction for the inheritance and innovation of traditional jade carving crafts.

articleTitle: The performance effect of CEO overconfidence on corporate long-term valuation: the case of international mergers and acquisitions
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: The effect of CEO overconfidence on firm performance has arouse great research interests because many CEOs are found characterized by overconfidence. By analysing international merger and acquisition (IMA) investments conducted by US companies between the periods of 2010-2020, this study finds different contingency effect of CEO overconfidence on corporate IMA long-term valuation, specifically from the following three perspectives: the degree of international diversification, degree of industrial interrelation, and culture distance between the merger and target. Findings of the present study can contribute to the literature by highlighting the importance of taking a contingency view to assess the influence of managerial overconfidence on the outcomes of firm strategic investment.

articleTitle: Experimentally investigation on solar hydrogen production efficiency of different gallium nitride films
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: This study experimentally investigates hydrogen production efficiency under sunlight exposure for gallium nitride (GaN) films. GaN is a semiconductor with a wide bandgap (3.3eV). It photoelectrochemical (PEC) effect brings about water splitting under ultraviolet light (wavelength less than 0.375μm) and hydrogen generation. Characteristics of each thin film sample are measured, and their generation efficiency is compared. The film samples vary in thickness (100 nm, 400 nm, 1000 nm), preparation methods (RF Sputter and MOCVD), and the presence absence of a zinc oxide (ZnO) anti-reflective layer. The measured target quantities include electrochemical performance, film characteristics, electrical properties, and radiative properties. The results will demonstrate the feasibility of sustainable hydrogen production using GaN thin films through green energy methods. The potential applications of wide bandgap semiconductors in the hydrogen energy industry will also be explored.

articleTitle: Analysis of pseudo-size of truss structure used in water heater storage system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: This paper simulates the structural deformation state of the truss structure used in the water heater water storage system when it is subjected to an earthquake, and uses the FEM software-Abaqus to evaluate the seismic performance of this structure in a quasi-static analysis method. The analysis of the truss structure used in the water heater storage system in this study is based on the formula defined by the Building Seismic Design and Code of the Building and Construction Department to convert the seismic force into horizontal force and vertical force. Finally, a quasi-scaled design was carried out on this structure, and seismic tests were conducted under two conditions of reducing the volume of this structure by 1/2 and 1/3, and the display of the experimental results was discussed. The stress and strain of the structure were reduced in equal proportions to the original size. This relationship can also provide manufacturers with reference for authentic experiments on new types of structural designs in the future, thereby saving experimental materials and funds. After the original size was reduced by 1/2 and 1/3, it was found that the horizontal stress after reducing the volume by 1/2 exceeded the yield strength of the material; the stress after reduction should not be reduced proportionally, so the measured horizontal earthquake force It has a nonlinear relationship with the vertical seismic force.

articleTitle: Application of combining piezoelectric carpet and virtual reality technology to enhance somatosensory interaction detection
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: With the development of VR technology, existing devices primarily focus on tracking the head and hands, while the perception of lower limbs and foot movements remains relatively limited. Therefore, improving the interaction sensing of the lower body has become an important topic for enhancing immersion. This study explores the application of piezoelectric carpet technology in improving lower limb interaction sensing and immersion in virtual reality (VR), as well as verifying its energy status.By designing and developing a piezoelectric carpet embedded with pressure and position sensors, precise footstep data from users can be captured. Next, the carpet system is integrated with VR, enabling real-time interaction between users' lower limb movements and virtual scenes. Furthermore, through comparative experiments, the impact of the piezoelectric carpet on immersion and motor performance is evaluated, followed by data analysis. Finally, the energy status of the carpet under different movement scenarios is tested. The results show that the piezoelectric carpet technology significantly enhances the realism of lower limb interactions and full-body motion feedback in VR experiences, while also demonstrating a certain level of energy recovery capability. This technology presents new possibilities for full-body interaction design in VR applications.

articleTitle: Nickel cover on carbon fiber for electromagnetic wave shielding application
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: Carbon fiber is a new type of material that has the advantages of light weight, high strength, low density, corrosion resistance, high temperature resistance, good heat dissipation performance, low thermal expansion coefficient, good flame retardant performance, and easy to form conductive circuits. This study uses electroplating to improve the metallization of the carbon fiber surface. Metal-based carbon fiber composites not only have the good properties of carbon fiber, but also retain the excellent characteristics of the matrix metal. However, due to the relatively high brittleness of carbon fiber, they lack convergence and friction resistance. This study uses electroplating to deposit a nickel film with a thickness of 2μm on the surface of carbon fiber bundles with a diameter of 7μm and carbon fiber cloth, for the subsequent application of carbon fiber in metallurgical bonding at the interface between anti-electromagnetic wave materials and metal matrix composite materials.

articleTitle: Liver cancer - tumour detection using image processing and ML techniques
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) stands as the predominant and most prevalent type of malignant liver cancer, encompassing a staggering 75 percent of diagnosed cases. Detecting liver cancer at an early stage is pivotal in enhancing life expectancy and improving outcomes. Hence, proposing a solution employing digital image processing and machine learning emerges an automated and computer-aided diagnosis system aimed at differentiating if the tumour is cancerous or non-cancerous and also determining its stage using CT/MRI images.

articleTitle: The framework for automating social media content publishing using google apps script
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: This study proposes a framework for automating social media content publishing using Google Apps Script, integrating insights from existing literature. It begins by reviewing current social media management tools and platforms, evaluating their strengths and limitations in automated publishing. Emphasizing the advantages of Google Apps Script as a lightweight tool, the study highlights scripting capabilities for automating content management. The framework focuses on key components such as content management, utilizing Google Sheets or cloud services for managing content databases with scheduling and categorization mechanisms; API integration, leveraging Google Apps Script to connect with social media platform APIs for automated publishing and data tracking; and error handling and logging, implementing mechanisms to ensure system stability and comprehensive logging for analysis. The study concludes by assessing the framework's strengths and limitations and explores future directions like content generation and developing user-friendly interfaces to reduce usage barriers.

articleTitle: Design and manufacture the structure of an inner grasper on a soft gripper
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: The main structural element of the soft gripper consists of a push-pull structure called an inner grasper to optimize the gripping performance of objects on the device. An inner grasper is essential for a robot arm to grab an object from one position to the other. This grasper technique utilizes the soft gripper's existing inside plane push. The material characteristics and elements structure of the device provide upright grasping performance. The aim of this study is to design a structural mechanism and use an elastomeric material to obtain the elasticity behaviour of this inner grasper’s characteristics. The device models were created by casting elastomeric material on a 3D printer and were molded in the bottom and top cavities. FEM was used to analyse the deformation of this inner grasper coupled with a soft gripper. The experiment was carried out using an inner grasper design installed on an existing soft gripper to measure the ability to flexibly and grip objects. Therefore, after analysing the deformation behaviour of this gripper, the results have shown virtuous comparison with real-grabbing experiments.

articleTitle: The user interface design of mobile financial applications based on the E-S-QUAL model
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: The intersection of FinTech and user interface (UI) design plays a critical role in shaping consumer trust and promoting the adoption of financial technologies. Recent studies have shown that UI design significantly impacts customer trust, perceptions of data security, and the overall user experience in FinTech applications. Additionally, the rapid adoption of FinTech solutions, accelerated by the COVID-19 pandemic, highlights the growing need for seamless and secure digital banking alternatives. However, despite these advancements, there remains a gap in how financial institutions design UIs that effectively meet user expectations while addressing key service quality dimensions. This study addresses this gap by applying the E-S-QUAL model to mobile financial applications' UI design. The E-S-QUAL model, with its focus on efficiency, system availability, fulfilment, and privacy, provides a structured approach to improving user satisfaction and trust. By integrating these dimensions, this research aims to develop a user-centric UI that aligns more closely with the diverse needs and expectations of FinTech users. Findings from this study will offer valuable insights for FinTech developers, contributing to the design of more efficient and trustworthy mobile financial applications.

articleTitle: Study on the creation strategies for enhancing the agglomeration space of intangible cultural heritage villages
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: The agglomeration space of intangible cultural heritage (ICH) villages, preserving the collective cultural memory of traditional villages, serving as a crucial venue for community engagement in public cultural activities, is vital for the protection and transmission of intangible heritage. However, due to changes in living environments, limitations in infrastructure, low economic levels, and issues such as underutilization or abandonment stemming from supply-demand imbalances, most ICH villages lack sufficient communal spaces and exhibit diminished vitality. Therefore, it is essential to focus on the creation and enhancement of agglomeration spaces within these villages to significantly boost their vibrancy and enrich the public cultural life of their inhabitants.

articleTitle: A new strategy for the design of a new type ultrasonic motor
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: This study developed an ultrasonic motor driven by circumferential traveling waves. A ridge is provided on the outer circumference of the disc-shaped stator to enhance the torsional rigidity of the stator. The outer ridge of the disc-shaped stator is equipped with a 30-degree inclined comb tooth to enlarge the amplitude of the traveling wave. The piezoelectric ring at the bottom of the stator is excited by dual-phase alternating current, generating two sets of flexure stationary waves with the same amplitude and a phase difference of 90 degrees. The two constructively interfere to form a traveling wave, which is transmitted circumferentially along the outer ridge of the stator, driving the rotor to rotate by friction. The direction of the motor's rotation is changed according to the leading or lagging phase of the two sets of stationary waves. The outer diameter, thickness and ridge height of the stator are used as design parameters, and the finite element method is used for numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Online classification of key appearances in the automated production line
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: In the automated key production line, different keys for different motorcycles need to be detected. This study uses the YOLO method to classify key with plastic cap and key without plastic cap, and to classify key with different serial numbers. Key (with or without plastic cap) detection is divided into three categories: With, Without, and Others. The sample training accuracy after extracting ROI is 0.942 (500 samples). The accuracy of key (serial numbers) classification for five different serial numbers after extracting ROI is 0.917 (1500 samples). The key automated production line changing station time is 2 seconds, and the total processing time of the two classification processes is less than 0.4 seconds, the results are feasible.

articleTitle: The application of generative AI in the creation of picture books for young children in early childhood education undergraduate course
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies are emerging as a critical technological capability of the 21st century and have been spreading their influence in various fields of education, including early childhood education (ECE) in recent years. When properly used and thoughtfully integrated into teaching, AI can be a powerful and effective tool in the classroom, not only to provide inspiration, generate ideas and encourage creativity for both children and teachers, but most importantly to prepare them for a future where technology plays an increasingly important role in schooling. For early childhood educators, AI can also be a tremendous assistant as an administrative helper, idea generator or data organizer, helping teachers to think outside the box and prepare for teaching more creatively and effectively. It appears that there is a growing need for early childhood educators to have not only pedagogical expertise but also a strong foundation in AI literacy, and that pre-service teachers need to be equipped with the ability to use AI appropriately in their formative or undergraduate stages. Therefore, this study aims to explore the ability of early childhood education students to use AI in the creation of picture books for young children, and seeks to provide insights into the potential strengths, weaknesses and ethical issues of integrating AI into early childhood education undergraduate course.

articleTitle: Design and evaluation of walking stick based on orthogonal experimental method
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: This article specifies the steps of orthogonal experimental method through the analysis of the functional demands of the rural elderly people to walking stick, making it applicable to the design and evaluation of the product. Through the analysis of the actual usage of walking sticks by the rural elderly people, the designing factors are ascertained, the factor levels are divided based on the questionnaire survey, interview and analysis of references, and the quantitative evaluation is made on all the samples by measuring the corresponding data. This method reduces the number of product samples, increases the efficiency and accuracy of product development, and provides a reference for product designers to quickly obtain the best solution.

articleTitle: Embodiment design of an inner grasper with rod structure on object-grabbing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: This paper presents a novel inner grasper design on a soft gripper for enhanced flexibility and reliability for object grasping. Comprising an elastic rod and a rod-plate structure as object surface grips and object-heavy retainer mounts. Innovative design ensures a secure grip, minimizing object movement and falls. The union contact area is believed to increase the grabbing force. FEM analysis and experiments demonstrate the grasper's adjustment, sensor-less contact area estimation, and closeness to each other.

articleTitle: Analysis of learning in higher education using the A6metric - a Vietnamese perspective
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: This research implanted the A<sup>6</sup>metric designed by Shen and Prior (2023) to measure Vietnamese University students’ performance and the use of their smartphone learning experience. There was a total of 317 Vietnamese University students who participated in this survey during July to September 2024. The A<sup>6</sup>metric uses six independent variables of: (i)<u>Accessibility</u>that refers to the capacity of network infrastructure; (ii)<u>Affordability</u>that refers to the user’s spending power for the cost of ownership of smartphones; (iii)<u>Adoptability</u>that refers to the user behaviour and cognitive patterns such as how to learn and use the gadgets; (iv)<u>Adaptability</u>that refers to the user who requires to deal with the unexpected circumstance and that which goes beyond their prior experience; (v)<u>Acceptability</u>that refers to user acceptance of willing to use of new technology; (vi)<u>Appropriateness</u>that refers to the content of embracing socio-cultural and religious values into the design model [1, 2]. The overall results indicated that the Vietnamese participants are slightly less positive (score of 65) in their responses to the questions. It is important to note that the A<sup>6</sup>metric has an inverse positivity scaling, in that a higher overall score denotes lower positivity (a neutral response being a score of 60). It has been postulated that to some degree this relates to the more diverse cultural drivers which exist within the Vietnamese society. In particular, the Vietnamese students appear to have a higher level of distrust in smartphone technology, suffer from high cost issues (relative to income) and relatively low internet speeds. The centralised control of the communist Vietnamese Government may have played a part in some of these issues. Future research will involve extending the research to other South-East Asian countries in order to develop a solid database of cultural happiness in terms of the A<sup>6</sup>metric.

articleTitle: Experimental study of silicone soft robot grippers using injection molding for hand rehabilitation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: Soft robots have proven to be an invaluable tool for humans. Soft grippers operated by a pneumatic system are often used in the medical field. This project aims to use injection molding to create a soft robot gripper for hand rehabilitation in one shot. Liquid Silicone Rubber (LSR) has traditionally been the favored choice for medical applications due to its platinum-catalyzed ease of manufacturing, low mechanical damping factors, and negligible toxicity. Due to the higher viscosity of LSR, it needs higher injection pressures to complete mold filling. So, discovering the lower viscosity of LSR and applying lower pressure is required to achieve more accessible and lower requirements in the manufacturing process. Designing, material selection, modeling, mold fabrication, and experiment data gathering are the first phases of the research process. Ansys will be utilized in structural analysis simulation to measure and compare these experiment variables to the outcomes. Finally, the fabrication of soft grippers and their future application to human rehabilitation will be revealed in this study. The design of a finger with a larger angle at the edge and using LSR as the primary material in an LSR injection molding process is a helpful invention for academic and medical purposes.

articleTitle: Bridging tradition and technology: gamification of intangible cultural heritage education through experiential gaming
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: This study explores the methods and educational effectiveness of transforming intangible cultural heritage (ICH) craft knowledge, specifically Foshan lion head crafting, into an E-learning game. Building on the S-O-R (Stimulus-Organism- Response) theory, along with Kolb's experiential learning theory and multimodal learning theories, this research analyses the process of converting traditional craft knowledge into a 3D interactive game. This effort led to the development of "Lion Dance Crafting Workshop," an interactive learning system aimed at teenagers interested in cultural heritage. The study finds that game mechanisms, such as task setting, interactive operations, and instant feedback, effectively convey the skills and cultural meanings of Foshan lion head crafting. Results indicate that integrating educational games with traditional craft education significantly enhances student engagement and cultural identity. This research provides a practical case for educators and game designers, offering insights into the development of digital teaching tools for ICH projects.

articleTitle: Research on aging-friendly furniture design for public spaces in urban rural areas - applications and challenges in China
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: With the rapid acceleration of population aging in China, there has been a consistent increase in the proportion of elderly individuals residing in urban and rural fringe areas, generating a growing demand for age-friendly design. Given the escalating aging population and heightened attention from the Chinese government towards this matter, this paper examines the current application and challenges associated with age-friendly furniture design concepts in public spaces within China's urban and rural fringe areas. While notable progress has been achieved in China concerning policies and theoretical research to promote age-friendly design, numerous challenges persist regarding systematic design, market penetration, and meeting individualized needs. By discussing and summarizing characteristics derived from international research on age-friendly design best practices, this paper proposes that future efforts should prioritize modular, multifunctional designs integrated with local culture while balancing smart technology integration with cost-effectiveness. These insights could serve as valuable references for age-friendly furniture design in public spaces of urban and rural fringe areas in China.

articleTitle: Dependency-aware patent claim generator
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: Patent claim drafting is a highly professional task conventionally done by humans. Here we demonstrate that given adequate fine-tuning, 7-13B large language models (LLMs) can outperform GPT-4 in this regard. The percentages of correctly generated claims increase from 4.0-35.0% before to 88.5-100.0% after fine-tuning. Particularly, Llama-2-13B reaches 100.0% correctness in claim dependency after fine-tuning, exceeding the 98.5% correctness yielded by GPT-4. Our results support the possibility of locally deploying LLMs for professional tasks on limited GPU resources.

articleTitle: Microstrip patch antenna structure prediction using machine learning and Bayesian optimization
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: The application of machine learning (ML) models to forecast microstrip patch antenna characteristics and maximize their performance via Bayesian optimization is presented in this study. Support Vector Regressor (SVR), K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), and Gradient Boosting Regressor (GBR) are the three machine learning models that are the subject of this study. Datasets produced by microstrip patch antenna simulations in CST Microwave Studio 2023 were used to train these models. Before training Machine learning models, the dataset is pre-processed as CST software does not give data in a format ready for training ML models. Pre-processing involved finding resonant frequency, bandwidth, and return loss of each curve's numerical data and considering these parameters as input into a machine learning model; slot distance, patch length, and patch width were considered as output of the parameters. Bayesian optimization was used to optimize these models' hyperparameters to increase forecast accuracy. Comparative research demonstrates how well ML models handle challenging antenna design problems, with Bayesian optimization significantly improving model performance.

articleTitle: Research on the art design innovation based on computer 3D aided system optimization
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: With the rapid development of technology, computer technology has been widely used in various fields, and the application in the field of art design is becoming increasingly prominent. As an emerging design tool, the computer 3D auxiliary system provides unlimited possibilities for artistic design innovation. By studying the innovation and optimization of the computer's 3D auxiliary system on art design, this article has in-depth understanding and analysis of the application and advantages of 3D auxiliary systems in art design innovation, and provides a reference for better application of 3D auxiliary system to innovate in art design.

articleTitle: Application of Taguchi-based grey relational analysis to optimize gripper modelling
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: The design of a gripper becomes a critical aspect of achieving decent grasping behavior in the actual application. This project aims to optimize a soft robot gripper design by utilizing a Taguchi-based Grey Relational Analysis (GRA) method to obtain multi-quality target optimization in deformation and tip maximal principal stress as a substitute for grasping force in actual application. Ansys in structural analysis simulation will be used to get these experiment data variables.

articleTitle: Research on risk assessment of industrial control system’s information security
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: Industrial systems, with their complex cybersecurity challenges, are the focus of this study. Driven by the imperative for comprehensive risk management, we, a team of seasoned professionals, utilize the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) to assess risks in industrial control systems. Our expert input identified vital risks, with "regular equipment inspections" ranked highest (13.92%). "Establishing effective communication" (12.34%) and "antivirus software" (9.50%) are deemed essential. Additionally, "authentication" (9.40%) and "scheduled maintenance" (10.25%) play significant roles. To further enhance accuracy, we supplement AHP with semi-structured interviews.

articleTitle: Optimized injection molding parameters design for an insert molding product
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: This study focuses on the deformation analysis of the logic gear, the main transmission element of the automobile rear test. Because it is designed to be an embedded combination of plastic and metal sheets, the forming is complex and the deformation is difficult to control. Therefore, the special topic uses CAE to divide the deformation into two parts: (1) Mold Deformation due to the pressure of the injection machine; (2) Deformation of plastic parts due to thermal expansion and contraction, helping companies analyse and understand the deformation situation so as to change the process to achieve precision manufacturing. In terms of mold deformation, this study uses finite element analysis software (ABAQUS) to analyse the deformation of the mold base of the injection molding machine after stress, and also analyses the static linear rigidity of the main component and the possible deformation of each mode under the natural frequency. Amount of change or damage. After analysis, the maximum deformation is 7.739E-2 mm. In addition to the mold flow analysis part, this topic first imports the plastic model into Rhinoceros to establish the flow channel and solid mesh, draws the water path and mold base, and exports it. After the export is successful, the Moldex3D/Solid suite of software is used to conduct mold flow analysis. The design of two cavities in one mold and three gates in each mold cavity has achieved the purpose of reducing warpage. After analysis, the maximum deformation is 0.06993mm. After measuring and comparing the injection finished products in this topic, the maximum total error is 0.14 mm, while the maximum total error based on simulation is 0.15mm, and the error ratio is 7%. It can be used as a reference for general companies.

articleTitle: Edge trigger and its applications
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: Edge Trigger is known to possess positive sensing capability by using NAND gate based Flip-Flop. On the other hand, J-K Master-Slave Flip-Flop using the same NAND gate based one negative-slope senses signals as the clock turning down to zero from high. J-K Master-Slave FF does have a lot of applications, including timer or counter design simply at J=1=K. Using the same design idea, an Edge Trigger counter is then generated. The new generated Edge Trigger counter/timer simplifies the use of number of transistors. It is then for sure an increase of transmitting speed of transferring data. Based upon TSMC 1.25µm process, Tanner software is used to verify if the design may be feasible. In addition, newly generated layout is proposed for the design and proven to be available in the Edge Trigger applications.

articleTitle: Self-powered UV photodetectors based on Gd-doped ZnO nanorods
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: In this investigation, gadolinium (Gd)-doped zinc oxide nanorod (NR) arrays were synthesized via low-temperature hydrothermal growth on ITO-PET substrates and incorporated into a self-powered flexible ultraviolet (UV) photodetector based on a piezoelectric nanogenerator. The optimal Gd doping concentration, estimated to be approximately 1.3% (15 mM Gd dopant), was measured using energy-dispersive spectroscopy. X-ray diffraction analysis revealed that the as-grown and Gd NRs exhibited a hexagonal wurtzite structure, which was further confirmed by transmission electron microscopy. A homemade tapping system powered the Gd:ZnO PENG, producing a dark voltage of 241 mV. When illuminated by UV light at wavelengths of 300 nm, 365 nm, and 400 nm, the PENG generated output voltages of 160 mV, 120 mV, and 165 mV, respectively, with sensitivity responses of 16.0 %, 22.67 %, and 1.0 %. These results demonstrate the good UV sensitivity and self-powered characteristics of the Gd-doped ZnO NRs-based PENG, operating without any external power supply.

articleTitle: Assessment of residual capacity in large-scale retired electric vehicle batteries: scientific questions and methods
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering 2024 (ICICE 2024)
abstract: The development of new energy vehicles has rapidly expanded the downstream industry, which is power battery recycling and utilization. The determination of residual capacity in retired power batteries is crucial for pricing battery recycling and hierarchical utilization. This paper focuses on the "economy-accuracy-fairness" coupled interactive mechanism required for assessing the residual capacity of large-scale retired electric vehicle batteries. It proposes scientific questions and a methodology for evaluating the residual capacity of retired batteries on a large scale. Based on this, mathematical models are established from three aspects: the economy, accuracy, and fairness of residual capacity assessment. Finally, a summary and outlook are provided regarding the technical challenges and innovative applications in the assessment of residual capacity in retired power batteries.
